candidate: SD-s30 exactly as chosen by results-engine-smoothing-01; no constant changes.

arms.SD-s30: Search change + sequential check, alpha 0.3 engine.

preprocessing: First audio track, channel 0, first 90 s, at least 51 s, first 40% tuning prefix, mean/std from prefix; no crops, loops or replacements.
seeds: 10 per room from tuning_decision.seeds_for; same for both arms and noise levels.
metrics: As decision-01: tone level, band_db, harmful keeps (prefix), room harms. Oracle errors not computed.
aggregation: Paired differences per room and seed, averaged over seeds per room, rooms per source, then sources; 95% percentile interval from 10000 source-bootstrap resamples.
decision: At sigma 1 SD-s30 passes only if (1) lower 95% bound of tone-level gain over O > 0, (2) harmful keeps <= O, (3) room harms <= O, (4) mean band_db difference >= -0.05 dB. Fewer than 12 eligible sources or 25 eligible rooms is inconclusive whatever the scores. Sigma 0.5 and 2 are descriptive.
failures: Missing, undecodable, short or silent files are reported and never replaced. Algorithm exceptions abort.
caveats: Purposive public collection; simulated listener, rooms and microphone; live timing unmeasured; no physical ANC claimed.
authorization: u have full autonomy proceed anddownload whatever u feel necessary

selection: Commons metadata and titles only, from the widened pool. Mechanical filters in research-tools/tuning-fresh-02/screen_wider.py, then a title and description screen in picks.txt. Every recording, uploader and author of earlier tests excluded; at most one per uploader and author.
rooms: 3 per source, seed fixed by room seed 20261031, recording id and room index; eligible if the v2 engine holds a tone in the tuning part.
relation_to_first_test: results-tuning-fresh-01 was inconclusive and its outcome was known at design. Its rule, arms and thresholds are copied unchanged; the tests are never pooled.
go_ahead: Yes, freeze a larger fresh test of SD-s30 on new recordings, sized for the 1-in-5 yield, and run it.
